verdict.rationale: Insomnia offers automation hooks tied to specific request lifecycle events—pre-request and after-response scripts that execute logic automatically when a request is sent/received, plus chaining and CLI-driven automated runs in CI—but this is scoped to request execution, not a general-purpose 'define a rule that triggers on an event' automation engine (e.g., webhooks, external triggers, scheduled events). Missing for 10: broader event-trigger/rules engine (e.g., scheduled or external-event-based triggers, conditional rule definitions beyond request scripting), independent hands-on confirmation of automation depth.
